method: Fix for the retracted cross-model text-encoder claim (cold_start_briefing.md §6). Each model's own native text encoder(s) (confirmed per-model from local model_index.json) encode the same 54 cultural prompts; multi-tower models concatenate each tower's L2-normalized pooled vector (native pooler/projection output where the architecture has one, else attention-masked mean-pool of the final hidden state), re-normalized after concatenation -- a defined convention for this probe, not a claim of pipeline-internals fidelity. Img×Img side is UNCHANGED from cross_model_clip_matrix.py (CLIP image embeddings) -- only the text side changes, since that was the actual flaw (SD 2.1's CLIP text tower was previously reused for all 6 models, which is only valid for SDXL).
